answer_1.quote: we evaluate the efficacy of our proposed framework across three knowledge-intensive tasks: MCQA, short-form and long-form open-ended generation

answer_2.quote: In evaluating performance on TruthfulQA, we report Accuracy for the MCQA task, alongside metrics of truthfulness (True), informativeness (Info), and a composite True * Info score, all evaluated using a fine-tuned GPT-3 model. For assessments on BioGEN, we present the FActScore percentage and the Respond ratio. Moreover, we quantify the correctness of generated content by reporting the number of accurate (cor) and inaccurate facts (incor) per response

answer_3.quote: we employ SELF-EVAL to evaluate the factuality of each atomic claim c relative to its atomic question q, leveraging the LLM's inherent knowledge
